name: Signature Weapon
body:
Benefit: Choose one weapon you own. You gain a competence bonus to hit with the weapon, based on your level.

Character Level
	Bonus to Hit

1st to 4th
	+1
5th to 8th
	+2
9th to 12th
	+3
13th to 16th
	+4
17th and up
	+5

Special: If the weapon is ever destroyed or you wish to choose a new signature weapon, the benefits of this feat apply to a new weapon after 24 hours. You may select this feat multiple times, each time granting the bonus with one additional weapon.
